# Oregon Public Broadcasting (OPB)

> > Oregon Public Broadcasting (OPB) is a nonprofit public media organization serving the Pacific Northwest with television, radio, and digital content.

OPB operates multiple service lines including OPB TV, OPB Radio, and KMHD Jazz Radio, delivering documentaries, news, and cultural programming to Oregon and Washington. The organization relies on member support and regional partnerships to fund its journalism and community engagement initiatives.
